description: American fashion label creating distinctive, art-inspired clothing, handbags and accessories designed to make a statement, sold through its own website and premium retailers.

evidence.summary: FlexOffers' own program page for Cult Gaia - US lists a 3.2% commission on sales with a 30-day cookie duration and application through the FlexOffers platform (page updated October 23, 2026).
Lasso's affiliate directory independently lists Cult Gaia at 3.2% per sale with a 30-day cookie, matching the FlexOffers program page.
Shopper.com lists a lower 1.6% payout for Cult Gaia, which reflects its own sub-network publisher payout rather than the FlexOffers program rate; the network-published 3.2% is the rate recorded.
FlexOffers describes Cult Gaia as a brand known for unique, artistic fashion pieces, best suited to publishers serving high-end fashion and lifestyle audiences.

name: Cult Gaia

reasons.compensation: A published network rate exists (3.2% per sale on FlexOffers), but it is at the low end for fashion, so compensation scores modestly.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the FlexOffers network only; no public partnerships contact or creator page was found on the brand's own site.
reasons.credibility: Established US designer label with its own retail presence and premium wholesale distribution, ranked in FlexOffers' apparel category since 2022.
reasons.niche_fit: Statement, highly visual fashion and accessories built for social content - squarely in the fashion creator niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through FlexOffers with standard network approval; no follower minimum published.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The FlexOffers program explicitly recruits publishers promoting on social media, blogs and websites, but no brand-run creator or ambassador program was found.

description: Online fashion marketplace launched in Seoul, South Korea in 2011, curating over 1,000 emerging independent designer labels from around the world - apparel, shoes, bags and K-beauty - through global storefronts including a US site.

evidence.summary: W Concept's own Awin merchant profile for the US program states 'W CONCEPT offers 8% commission as default' with a 30-day cookie length.

The Awin profile describes W Concept as an online marketplace of emerging independent designers launched in Seoul, Korea in 2011, now carrying over 1,000 labels across fashion, independent designers, apparel, shoes, bags and K-beauty.

Sub-network wrappers list lower effective payouts for W Concept (Yazing 6%, Takeads up to 3.6%); these are reseller payouts, not the Awin program's published 8% default rate, which is what is recorded.

The brand separately promotes a 'W Ambassador' creator program on its social channels at a reported 10% commission, but no public application page or terms could be fetched, so the verified Awin program is the recorded route.

name: W Concept

reasons.compensation: Awin's own merchant profile publishes an 8% default commission with a 30-day cookie - a solid, verified fashion rate.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through Awin only; no public partnerships email or creator application page was found.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2011 with 1,000+ designer labels and global storefronts, though less established in the US market than domestic peers.
reasons.niche_fit: Emerging-designer and K-fashion marketplace with strong visual, discovery-driven product - a strong fit for fashion creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin's US program with standard network approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator ambassador effort is promoted on the brand's social channels, and the Awin program supports content publishers, but no detailed public creator program page could be verified.

description: Greek online ferry booking platform covering 4,000+ ferry routes across 63+ countries with over 360 ferry operators - strongest in the Mediterranean and the Greek islands - used by more than 6 million travelers to compare and book ferry tickets.

evidence.summary: Ferryhopper's own partner hub runs its affiliate program directly: affiliates earn commission on every booking made through their links, banners or widgets, with an extended cookie window, dedicated affiliate support and an application form on the page.

The partner hub does not publish a commission rate, and Ferryhopper's affiliate terms keep rates confidential; third-party network listings conflict (FlexOffers lists 1.6% US / 2.4% CA), so no rate is recorded.
Ferryhopper's homepage reports 6M+ travelers, 10M tickets sold, 4,000+ routes and 360+ ferry operators across 63+ countries; the company address shown is in Moschato, Greece.

name: Ferryhopper

reasons.compensation: The program pays commission on every booking, but the rate is unpublished and third-party figures conflict, so compensation stays at the no-verified-rate band.
reasons.contact_access: A public application form on the brand's own partner hub plus a dedicated affiliate support team - above mid-range per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Large, established booking platform (6M+ travelers, 10M tickets sold) with a published Greek headquarters address.
reasons.niche_fit: Ferry and island-hopping bookings are a natural monetization layer for Mediterranean and Europe travel content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application form on the partner hub; the team reviews and responds to applicants.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is explicitly pitched at turning travel content into revenue, with widgets and banners for content sites, but no structured creator cohort or ambassador program is published.

description: Los Angeles women's fashion brand known for feminine, whimsical dresses, lingerie-inspired pieces and occasion wear, sold through its own website and premium retailers.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists For Love & Lemons on the Impact platform at 1.5%-3% commission per sale, described as the rate officially listed with the program (page last updated March 10, 2024).
Other sources conflict with LinkClicky's range - Shopper.com lists 5-10% and AffJumbo lists 3.2% - so no single rate could be verified and commission_rate is left null.
NetInfluencer's guide reports For Love & Lemons works with influencers and brand ambassadors alongside its affiliate program, with each affiliate application reviewed by its team.
The brand's official homepage sells women's apparel, dresses, lingerie and accessories and gives its address as 3117 Beverly Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90057.

name: For Love & Lemons

opportunity.title: For Love & Lemons Affiliate Program (via Impact)

reasons.compensation: An Impact program exists, but published rates conflict across sources (1.5-3% vs 3.2% vs 5-10%), so no verified rate can be credited.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through Impact only; no public partnerships email or creator page was verified on the brand's own site.
reasons.credibility: Established Los Angeles label with national premium retail distribution and a long-running e-commerce operation.
reasons.niche_fit: Highly visual, occasion-driven women's fashion with a strong social following - squarely in the fashion creator niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application via Impact is open but each application is reviewed by the brand's team.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand actively collaborates with influencers and ambassadors per creator-industry reporting, alongside its network affiliate program.

description: Premium knitwear brand selling cashmere sweaters and knit essentials for women and men through its own website, built on timeless style and quality over quantity.

evidence.summary: NAADAM's own Brand Ambassador page invites creators to join its ambassador team for free product, early access to drops and commission on each sale made through their content; ambassadors are asked to post at least once a month, the brand is primarily interested in Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, and international creators are encouraged to apply.

The ambassador FAQ confirms ambassadors 'receive a percentage of sales made through their content' plus free product, but the page does not publish the percentage; third-party listings citing 5-10% (Shopper, InfluencerRate) are uncorroborated by the brand, so commission_rate is left null.

name: Naadam

reasons.compensation: Commission on sales plus free product is confirmed on the brand's own page, but the percentage is unpublished, keeping compensation in the lower band.
reasons.contact_access: A public ambassador application page on the brand's own site with a detailed FAQ - above mid-range per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Established premium knitwear label with its own e-commerce operation and national brand recognition.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium knitwear and cashmere essentials - a good fashion fit, though a narrower, higher-price niche than trend fashion.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are publicly open on the official site, including to international creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal, brand-run ambassador program with defined monthly content expectations across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube - strong, first-party UGC evidence.

description: Guided-tour operator running multi-day coach tours and river cruises across Europe, the Americas, Asia and beyond, part of The Travel Corporation family of travel brands.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists Trafalgar's affiliate program on CJ Affiliate at 5% commission per sale, described as the rate officially listed with the program (page last updated March 11, 2024).

JEBCommerce, the agency that launched Trafalgar's CJ program, announced 5% of online sales plus $4 per qualifying call over 5 minutes and $5 per quote-request lead, with a 90-day cookie and $2,750 average order value.

Lasso lists 6.4% per sale for Trafalgar and one travel roundup claims payouts run through Impact at 5-10%; these conflict with the CJ program's documented 5%, so commission_rate is left null while the network is recorded as CJ Affiliate on the strength of two CJ-specific sources.

Trafalgar's official site sells guided tours and river cruises worldwide (trips typically $2,500-$5,300 per person) and identifies it as part of The Travel Corporation family alongside Uniworld and Contiki.

name: Trafalgar

reasons.compensation: A CJ program with lead bounties exists, but the headline rate conflicts across sources (5% vs 6.4% vs 5-10%), so no verified rate can be credited.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through CJ Affiliate only; no public partnerships email was verified.
reasons.credibility: One of the world's largest guided-tour operators, part of The Travel Corporation, with decades of operating history.
reasons.niche_fit: Guided tours are a core travel-creator monetization category, though the audience skews older than the typical short-form creator audience.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through CJ Affiliate with standard network approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is publisher- and affiliate-focused with dedicated account management, but no creator-specific program or ambassador structure is published.

description: Spanish footwear brand founded on Mallorca in 1975 - a family business known for inventive, design-led shoes with a Mediterranean heritage, sold in 35+ countries through its own stores and website.

evidence.summary: Camper's program description (program listed on CJ, Awin and Admitad) publishes an 8% commission on full-price products and 6% on sale products, a 14-day cookie and an average basket of 150 EUR; it names emiliapolewka@cj.com at CJ as the program contact.
Shopper.com corroborates the 8% headline payout for Camper, while Yazing's US listing shows up to 6%, consistent with the published sale-item tier; the published full-price rate of 8% is recorded.
The program description identifies Camper as a contemporary footwear brand from Mallorca, Spain, founded in 1975 as a family business with a rich shoemaking heritage, available in 35 countries.

name: Camper

reasons.compensation: Published tiered rates of 8% on full-price and 6% on sale products, corroborated by a second directory - a solid verified fashion rate.
reasons.contact_access: A named CJ program contact email is published in the program description, though there is no brand-side application page.
reasons.credibility: Family footwear brand operating since 1975 with global retail distribution across 35+ countries.
reasons.niche_fit: Design-led footwear with distinctive, content-friendly silhouettes - a strong fit for fashion and styling creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through CJ (also listed on Awin and Admitad) with standard network approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program supports content publishers with product feeds and premium partnerships, but no brand-run creator or ambassador program was found.

description: Short-term luggage storage network that books bag storage in local shops, cafes and hotels in 210 cities across 53 countries, letting travelers store bags by the hour with insurance included.

evidence.summary: LuggageHero's own Awin merchant profile for the US program lists a 10% standard commission, a 30-day cookie lifetime and the opportunity for higher CPA by special agreement, and names anna.gabriela@luggagehero.com as the affiliate team contact.

LuggageHero's own help center documents the tiers on top of the 10% default: 15% at 200+ qualified clicks per month, 20% at 500+, plus a +5% bonus for qualifying blog content, with support at affiliate@luggagehero.com.

name: LuggageHero

reasons.compensation: A verified 10% standard commission on Awin, with the brand's own help center documenting tiers up to 20% plus a blog-content bonus - the strongest published pay in this group.
reasons.contact_access: Two published affiliate contacts: a named affiliate team email on the Awin profile and a support email in the brand's own help center.
reasons.credibility: Operating in 210 cities across 53 countries with 1,000+ storage locations, though a smaller brand than the major travel platforms.
reasons.niche_fit: Luggage storage is a practical travel-hack topic that fits travel creator content well, though it is a utility service rather than an aspirational product.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin's US program with standard network approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program explicitly rewards blog content with a commission bonus and targets travel bloggers and content sites, but runs no formal ambassador cohort.

description: Travel monetization platform for creators and publishers that turns accommodation mentions and links into bookable hotel content across partners such as Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com and GetYourGuide, paying a revenue share on resulting bookings.

evidence.summary: Stay22's creator campaign page describes it as the monetization layer behind 5,000+ creators and publishers driving over $1B in annual travel bookings through partners like Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, GetYourGuide, Agoda and Kayak; commissions start at 30%, there is no cost to join and no follower or traffic minimum, and links can be dropped into Instagram bios, TikTok captions, YouTube descriptions, blogs and newsletters.

Stay22 operates on a revenue-share model: the publisher's share starts at 30% of the commission Stay22 itself receives from the booking partner (reported as negotiable up to 80% at volume). The 30% figure recorded is that revenue-share percentage, not a percentage of booking value, so effective earnings per booking vary by partner.

name: Stay22

reasons.compensation: A published 30% starting revenue share of the commission Stay22 receives - meaningful pay, but it is a share of commission rather than of booking value, so effective rates vary by partner.
reasons.contact_access: Sign-up is self-serve on the platform; no public partnerships email was verified.
reasons.credibility: Established travel-tech platform reporting $1B in annual partner bookings, though smaller than the OTAs it aggregates.
reasons.niche_fit: Built specifically to monetize travel content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and blogs - a near-perfect fit for travel creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join with no follower or traffic minimum - the most open availability in this group.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The platform is creator-first by design (5,000+ creators and publishers, tools that monetize existing social and blog content), though that scale also means saturation is not low.

description: Boutique river cruise line running all-inclusive luxury river cruises in Europe, Asia and Egypt aboard small ships averaging around 130 guests, part of The Travel Corporation.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists Uniworld's affiliate program on CJ Affiliate at 5% commission per sale for the US region, described as the rate officially listed with the program.

JEBCommerce's announcement of managing the Uniworld affiliate program confirms a 5% commission rate with a 90-day cookie, dedicated account management and a $10,000 average order value on the Commission Junction network (MID 4647697).

Affiliate-toolkit's Uniworld program page reproduces the program description (5% commission per confirmed online booking, 90-day referral cookie, creative and reporting provided) and invites questions to the Uniworld affiliate team at cjaffiliate@ttc.com.

name: Uniworld

reasons.compensation: A verified 5% per sale on CJ - modest as a percentage, but on a ~$10,000 average booking it is worth several hundred dollars per conversion.
reasons.contact_access: A published affiliate team email (cjaffiliate@ttc.com) plus dedicated account management through the program manager.
reasons.credibility: Award-winning luxury river cruise line within The Travel Corporation, with the highest staff-to-guest ratio positioning in its category.
reasons.niche_fit: Luxury river cruising fits high-end travel content well, though the price point narrows the addressable creator audience.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through CJ Affiliate with standard network approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is publisher-focused with creative assets and reporting, but no creator-specific or ambassador program is published.
